newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: 1Q NATIONAL BUDGET DEFICIT 50.5 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: 1Q NATIONAL BUDGET DEFICIT 50.5 MLN LITAS.

text.p: The Lithuanian statistics department said on Tuesday that the deficit of the country's state and municpal budgets was 50.5 million litas in the first quarter of 1997.
The statistics department said in a statement that the revenues to the national budget were 1.578 billion litas and expences amounted to 1.626 billion litas in the first quarter of the year.
It also said that 93.9 percent of total revenues were taxes and 1.48 billion in taxes had been collected in the first three months of the year.
Social affairs accounted for 47.3 percent of expences.
The statement said that 33.4 percent of total expences was spent on government administration and 3.4 percent of it on defence.
The statement also said that social security fund's deficit in the first quarter of the year amounted to 73.8 million litas.
The fund collected 687.8 million litas in revenues and made 761.6 million litas in expences.
